mapping_correction.finding: ROUND33 indexed the lexically sorted `group.batch_records` list with the numeric batch number. At b15 this selects list position 15 (record b22); at b31 it selects position 31 (record b9). This created the 12 reported b15/b31 conflicts.
mapping_correction.correction: join by each sidecar's explicit `batch` field and verify its filename suffix

hash_namespace_rules.file_sha256: hash of serialized .pt file bytes; compare only with file/index SHA256
hash_namespace_rules.controller_parameter_sha256: parameter-content digest claim using sorted module-prefixed names and contiguous tensor bytes; not recomputed here
hash_namespace_rules.module_digests: four independent truncated module-level digests; do not compare with whole-controller or file SHA256
hash_namespace_rules.batch_record_identity: episodes, scenarios, lambda, batch index, update counts, and saved hash claims; not checkpoint tensor content

checkpoint_verification_limit: PyTorch is unavailable. Matching file SHA256 proves bytes match the index entry only. Corrected metadata alignment proves archived JSON claims and tape counts are internally consistent, but does not prove the serialized .pt payload contains those parameters.
